scope: One selected authored regression, with eight new synthetic cases, of AST-extracted publish_attempt and three JSON-key helpers using stdlib bindings and a disclosed test-local write_json substitute; no project import, production JSON writer, parser replay, provider request, scientific study or historical stream repair.
runtime_identity_scope: Captured Python/platform strings and the installed pytest distribution version only; no interpreter executable or package-content identity, and no lockfile agreement was enforced.
counts_and_timing_scope: Execution bookkeeping; no provider, scientific, performance, financial or ROI evidence.
source_identity_scope: Five authored source/test/configuration/dependency-declaration files; not an import closure or installed package-content inventory.

execution_seam.method: AST-extract the full publish_attempt and exactly three JSON-key helpers with stdlib bindings.
execution_seam.writer: Disclosed test-local write_json substitute; production writer not executed.
execution_seam.inputs: New synthetic tmp_path files only; no retained provider stream or historical capture input.

publication_contract.same_object_post_redaction_collision: Omit the whole event; roll back that event's redaction count.
publication_contract.collision_public_json_value: public event omitted: JSON object key collision after profile redaction
publication_contract.collision_wire_form: One JSON string line, not a JSON event object.
publication_contract.collision_parser_scope: A valid raw object can become a public string and yield invalid_event; the parser is not replayed by this check.

captured_regression_coverage: Nested POSIX and escaped Windows decoded profile keys and values are redacted; ordinary Unicode and escaped lone surrogates survive the specified serialization.
Collisions between two transformed keys or a transformed and existing marker key omit the whole event across insertion orders.
Redactions from an omitted event are rolled back while preceding counts and following shallow events survive.
Equal redacted keys in separate objects remain allowed.
Exact public event bytes, raw/public hashes, the seven-field record, local sink/readback arguments, unchanged raw inputs and verbatim synthetic metadata copies are asserted.
limitations: This is one selected synthetic AST regression with a disclosed local writer substitute, not project import or production JSON writer integration.
Raw/public parser replay is not executed; collision omission can yield invalid_event and has no parser-equivalence claim.
Existing profile-prefix regular expressions, malformed/overnested fallback and strict raw UTF-8 limitations are unchanged.
Request, schema and receipt metadata are copied verbatim; this is no general metadata sanitation or confidentiality guarantee.
No live provider, independent live editor, usage-admission, provider-origin or scientific validation is supplied.
No historical stream is inspected, repaired or replayed; earlier receipts retain their captured source scopes.
The 90 historical failures' usage, charges and deployment revision remain unknown, with no finite total-cost bound or independent provider-origin attestation.
Runtime continuity concerns strings and installed pytest version metadata, not interpreter executable/package contents or lockfile agreement.
The recorded test does not verify later documentation/publication edits or hosted CI.

publication.scope: Retained identities and publication baselines checked with stdlib and read-only Git; no project execution.
